frame.origin: Existing estimated bar-clamp datum, not physical seat mounting datum

scope.included: Finite outer upholstery skin over variable crown, shoulders, side skirts and visible front/rear faces. Open underside lower perimeter declared explicitly.
excluded: Base ribs/supports/staples until separately read and modeled

construction.method: Editable sparse longitudinal cross-section cage with independently defined width, crown, lower edge and nose sweep; Catmull-Clark limit approximation for continuous upholstered rolls, then explicit finite skin offset and lower-edge thickness closure. No capsule primitive.
construction.side_symmetry: Initial main envelope symmetric estimate, separate left/right controls retained. Not evidence of manufactured bilateral identity.
construction.ranges_are: Design exploration only, not physical confidence intervals or published dimensions
construction.thickness_is: Authored inspection skin only, not measured vinyl or foam

before_material: Actual source/export area, closed wall edges/volume, finite normals and UV
Fixed R00/R04 ORTHO and PERSP50 hypotheses, same guide/cameras as tank; never deform solely to absorb uncertain camera
Whole upper oblique and opposite side gray, neutral reflection and bottom scope short previews, actual camera preflight
Compare current exterior to isolated related top and rear without asserting they are calibrated or samevariant
uncertainty: Unknown camera, perspective, silhouette depth and rack occlusion remain separate from section controls. No pixel bound implies dimensional fidelity.
